description:
Report that a TraderMatrix learn page is wrong, outdated, or missing something.
Use only when the user (or you, after reading the page) found a concrete problem with
the docs. page is the page URL or slug; issue says what is wrong (10-2048
characters, no links). Limited to 5 reports an hour per caller.

issue.description: What is wrong or missing, in plain words

page.description: Page URL or slug, e.g. heat-map

name: send_docs_feedback
title: Send Docs Feedback
